Company Profile & Manufacturing Operations

Manufacturing pure roasted and cold-pressed mustard oil in Hetauda, Nepal. Dedicated to authentic taste, dual processing expertise, and consistent quality.

About Dakshina Tel Mill

Hetauda’s Dedicated Mustard Oil Mill

Dakshina Tel Mill is an edible oil manufacturer located in Hetauda, Nepal. We craft two distinct product lines — Roasted Mustard Oil (भुटेको तोरीको तेल / चेपुवा) and Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (कच्ची घानी) — offering both 500 ml and 1000 ml pouches. Our dedication lies in providing pure, unadulterated oil that enriches Nepali meals.

Operating from the historic manufacturing hub of Hetauda, Nepal, Dakshina Tel Mill produces both Roasted Mustard Oil (Chepuwa) and Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (Kacchi Ghani). Packaged in 500 ml and 1000 ml food-grade pouches, our products combine time-honored milling recipes with strict packaging hygiene.

Strategic Orientation

Our Mission & Vision

Corporate Objective

Our Mission

To deliver uncompromised purity and choice to Nepali households and food businesses by producing both roasted and cold-pressed mustard oil in hygienic, accessible packaging formats.

Purity, Hygiene & Consumer Choice
Future Horizon

Our Vision

To establish Dakshina as one of Nepal’s premier edible oil brands, admired for honest milling practices, diverse processing capabilities, and dependable dealer networks.

Honest Milling & Dependable Dealer Networks
Manufacturing Infrastructure

Our Production Capabilities

Combining authentic Nepali oil expelling traditions with modern food-grade packaging automation.

Smoky & Pungent

Dedicated Roasted Chepuwa Processing

Automated thermal seed roaster coupled with heavy-duty mechanical expellers for intense aroma and pungency.

Verified Standard
Raw & Unheated

Virgin Cold-Pressed Extraction Line

Temperature-controlled mechanical crushers operating below 45°C to preserve natural vitamins and antioxidants.

Verified Standard
500ml & 1L Packs

High-Speed Sealed Pouch Packaging

Automated multi-layer pouch fill and seal units handling 500ml and 1000ml SKUs with zero hand contact.

Verified Standard
Tested Purity

In-House Laboratory Batch Testing

Systematic batch-wise verification for moisture content, free fatty acids (FFA), iodine values, and optical clarity.

Verified Standard
Our Guiding Principles

Core Values

Culinary Choice

Offering both roasted (Chepuwa) and cold-pressed varieties in multiple volumes (500ml & 1L) to meet all market needs.

02

Uncompromised Purity

Commitment to Excellence

Our Commitment to Quality & Safety

Every batch of Dakshina Mustard Oil is tested for clarity, pungency, and density. Sealed immediately at the mill, our multi-layer pouches safeguard oil against contamination and UV exposure from our factory floor to your table.
